The '''Tromper Crags''' was the mountain ridge that formed the eastern side of [[Highmount Ridge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], bordering the [[Glacial Fissure]] on its eastern side. The Crags' eastern side was known as the [[Bold Ascent]], and the [[Tromper Crags Geothermal Plant]] and the surrounding complex dominated most of the Tromper Crags.
